crit: '21 multi-class imbalanced datasets from the UCI repository' for a method tailored to multi-class imbalance; 'The selected dataset is real and diverse'; 'The collection contains datasets with varying levels of imbalance, with IRoverall ranging from 1.65 to 391.52 and the IR values ranging from 1.89 to 87.47.'
notes: Tables 1, 3, 4 are images (pdf p.5-7); values read from the PDF. No preprocessing of the UCI data is described, so origin coded Natural only; however several Table 1 entries look like reduced or regrouped versions of the UCI sets (e.g. Connect-4 N 6756 with 3 classes, Letter Recognition 10 classes/10723, Chess (King-Rook vs. King) 8 classes/2376, Abalone 13 classes/3966, Covertype 5781, Avila 11 classes) without any explanation - adjudicator may want to check. Internal inconsistencies in Table 1: Cardiotocography distribution 1655/295/176 sums to 2126 vs N 1728; Wine Quality-White distribution sums to 4898 vs N 4895; Bar Crawl distribution not in descending order (1212/1277). IR defined as largest/smallest class (p.196933) and also per class IRi = Nmax/Ni (p.196931-2). Minority rule: IRi > 1.45 threshold taken from [34]. No dataset or code link given.
